positions.name: ForgetRequestScope
positions.frame: what knowledge is this actor asking to have removed from the record, and under what single act of forgetting?
positions.why: Both segments are directives issued by the same actor in the same envelope on the same date, each naming a distinct subject (a decision, a migration) but sharing one directional read: an instruction to erase prior knowledge. Read together, they define the scope of a single forget-request rather than two unrelated asks; the tension is that the two named subjects (the Quantum Widget Decision; the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration) have no prior standing in the graph at all — the position covers a request whose targets are themselves absent from the perspective.
